title: Integral-stage identity and composition for normalized ring refinement maps
statement: Fix normalized construction records R,F,M,N with exactly the geometric hypotheses and coefficient categories of [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data]. Fix one finite extension E of Q_l. At the completed integral stage Stage.integral E, the actual left refinement isomorphisms supplied by N satisfy identity and composition: N.refinement(id c).left = Iso.refl and N.refinement(r.comp t).left = N.refinement(r).left trans N.refinement(t).left. Only the integral coefficient case is asserted, with no finite, rational or closed coefficient laws. All comparisons and normalizations are those of the supplied records, not newly selected maps.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_normalized_ring_refinement_laws
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : CoefficientConstructionRing.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R)
    (M : CoefficientConstructionCommon.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F)
    (N : CoefficientConstructionRefinements.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F M)
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) :
    (∀ c : Compactification f, (N.refinement (.id c) (.integral E)).left = Iso.refl _) ∧
    (∀ {a b c : Compactification f} (r : a.Refinement b) (t : b.Refinement c),
      (N.refinement (r.comp t) (.integral E)).left =
        (N.refinement r (.integral E)).left ≪≫
          (N.refinement t (.integral E)).left)
